subject: Mutual Action Sprint — GCP advance offer, billing & procurement runway
messages:
From: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@lumina-systems.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@lumina-systems.com
Date: Wed, 01 May 2028 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Can we compress the MAP and close on GCP private offer by 5/12?

Hi Tessa,

Quick note from procurement at Lumina — we’ve had an internal budget reforecast and there’s an opportunity to move this to a May close if we can tighten the mutual action plan. Current blockers are: legal review (our counsel is slow), billing setup for GCP Marketplace private offer, and an I/T security checklist (SOC2 evidence + KMS key options).

Can you and Redwood help compress the timeline and give a short, actionable sprint-style MAP with owners and dates? Ideally we’d like:
- an updated MAP by EOD 5/1
- legal-ready PO or private-offer draft for Lumina legal by 5/5
- billing/invoicing run (GCP billing contact + invoicing cadence) completed by 5/9
- signatures / DocuSign by 5/12

I’ve attached our internal procurement intake for context (short). We’d prefer Redwood to route the private offer but will accept a self-service PO if it’s faster.

Thanks — Alice

-- 
Alice Monroe
Head of Procurement, Lumina Systems
alice.monroe@lumina-systems.com
procurement@lumina-systems.com
Attachment: lumina_procurement_intake.pdf (1 page)
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@lumina-systems.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 May 2028 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Can we compress the MAP and close on GCP private offer by 5/12?

Thanks Alice — I can own the MAP and accelerate this. High level plan below; Ben and Lauren are looped for legal/billing and marketplace ops. I will send a one-sheet MAP attachment and a short meeting invite to align owners.

Immediate asks from Redwood side:
- Confirm Lumina legal contact (name + email) for redlines and desired contract term length.
- Confirm billing entity (billing email + PO number if available).
- Any mandatory security controls beyond SOC2 and KMS (e.g., data residency)?

Proposed sprint milestones (quick):
1) 5/01 (today): Redwood sends MAP one-sheet + draft private-offer form (attached). Owner: Tessa
2) 5/03: Legal and security questions consolidated; Redwood provides SOC2 evidence link and KMS options. Owner: Ben
3) 5/05: Lumina legal provides redlines OR sign-off on private-offer draft. Owner: Lumina legal / Lauren to support
4) 5/08: GCP private offer submitted / billing details reconciled. Owner: Lauren
5) 5/12: DocuSign complete & first invoice issued (if required). Owner: Lumina procurement

I’ll attach Redwood_MAP_v3.xlsx as a fillable plan so we can track owners/dates/status. If that looks good, I’ll book a 30-min sprint sync for 5/2 to walk the plan.

Thanks again — looking forward to moving quickly.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v3.xlsx, GCP_Private_Offer_Form_Draft.pdf
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@lumina-systems.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 May 2028 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Sprint — GCP advance offer, billing & procurement runway

Adding legal and billing nuance here. Per Lumina ask, I’ve summarized the critical path with dependencies and estimated turnaround times — copied below. I’m also including links to our SOC2 package and the marketplace billing checklist.

Critical path (detailed):
- Legal review (Lumina legal): turnaround 2 business days for initial redlines if we get the draft by 5/03. Redwood legal will standby for immediate review once redlines come in (same-day for commercial redlines).
- GCP private offer submission: requires commercial terms + accepted quote + billing account ID. If Redwood submits (recommended), we can pre-fill the private offer form and loop Lumina for a single-sign approval. Submission to GCP typical 24–48 hrs for processing once complete.
- Billing/invoicing: need billing entity, tax ID, contact email. If Lumina needs monthly invoicing we’ll set Net 30 terms; otherwise, we can configure marketplace invoicing. Lauren, can you confirm who owns marketplace submit?

Milestone table (owner / target):
- 5/01 (Tessa): MAP v3 distributed (done)
- 5/03 (Ben): SOC2 & KMS options shared + security Q&A doc (I’ll upload to shared Drive)
- 5/05 (Lumina legal): redlines back OR explicit sign-off
- 5/06 (Lauren): Redwood submits private offer to GCP (if signed or pre-approved)
- 5/09 (Finance): billing reconciliation complete; first invoice date agreed
- 5/12 (Both): DocuSign complete and account live on marketplace

Attached: Redwood_SOW_summary.docx (high level SOW), link to SOC2 evidence: https://redwood.docs/soc2-report (internal link, shared with Lumina).

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Chris Williams <chris.williams@lumina-systems.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@lumina-systems.com>, procurement@lumina-systems.com
Date: Thu, 02 May 2028 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Sprint — GCP advance offer, billing & procurement runway

Ben/Tessa — thanks for the clear steps. Quick notes from Lumina legal/finance:
- Legal contact: Maren Holt (maren.holt@lumina-systems.com). She’s agreed to a 48-hour turnaround if we get a clean draft.
- Billing entity: Lumina Systems, Inc. Tax ID: 12-3456789. Billing contact: finance@lumina-systems.com. PO#: will be supplied by 5/06 latest.
- Security: SOC2 attestation is sufficient for now; KMS option preferred (we’ll use Lumina-managed keys). No extra residency constraints.

We’re comfortable for Redwood to submit the GCP private offer if that speeds processing — please include Lumina legal as approver during submission. We’ll expect an invoice only after DocuSign completes unless Redwood needs a deposit.

I’ll coordinate with Maren to expedite redlines once the draft is in her inbox.

Thanks — Chris
Director, IT & Security, Lumina Systems
ctwilliams@lumina-systems.com
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Monroe <alice.monroe@lumina-systems.com>, Chris Williams <chris.williams@lumina-systems.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 May 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Sprint — GCP advance offer, billing & procurement runway

Great — we have the inputs. Final checklist and immediate next steps from Redwood: 
1) I attached the finalized private-offer PDF (GCP_Private_Offer_Form_Draft.pdf) pre-filled with Lumina terms where available. Please review and flag any edits by 5/03 EOD.
2) DocuSign envelope prepared: https://app.docusign.com/secure/start?envelopeId=ABC123XYZ — I’ll add Maren (lumina legal) and Alice as signers once we have redline confirmation. Target: sign by 5/12.
3) Billing setup: Lauren will submit marketplace private offer on 5/06 (if we have a pre-approval email from Maren) and finance@lumina-systems.com will receive the invoice once DocuSign completes.
4) Security package: Ben has uploaded SOC2 evidence and KMS guidance to the shared Drive (link below).

Please confirm:
- Lumina will provide PO number by 5/06 (Chris / Alice)
- Maren will aim for redlines within 48 hours of receiving the draft (Maren)

I’ll open a shared tracker and update status as we progress — Redwood_MAP_v3.xlsx attached for live updates. If anyone prefers a quick 15-min sync this afternoon to unblock details, I’m available at 4:30pm PST.

Thanks all — we’ll push to the May close.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Commercial Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
